rows.grounds: correlative temporal adverb indicating duration until a condition changes
compound: moha (delusion) + ātman (self/nature), describing those whose being is characterized by delusion
middle member referring to conditions or states of existence
final member of compound nānā-bhāva-anubandhana, denoting binding connections or attachments

items.question: What keeps delusion-natured beings wandering through various states and attachments?
premises: Beings whose nature is delusion continue to wander.
Their wandering persists through various states.
These states are experienced as binding attachments.
items.inference: Delusion sustains continued wandering by binding beings to diverse states and attachments.
uncertainties: The endpoint implied by tāvat is not explicitly stated in this verse and depends on context.
items.plain_english: So long, those whose nature is delusion wander on, bound by attachments to various states.
